items.item: DDU Digital Design Unit, TU Darmstadt

Fetches identities (with their current snapshot) from the remote Catalog based on filter criteria (type, material, dataset, complexity, fragment, bounding box dimensions). Mirrors the web catalog filter menu and returns compose JSON ({identity, snapshots[]}) results.
